name: revenue-anomaly-explainer
description: Checks a day of subscription revenue movement in your own payments account (default: yesterday, UTC; also a named date or the last N days, up to 7) against a trailing baseline (28 days by default, 14 to 60): new, churned, expansion, contraction and net new MRR plus failed payments, per currency. Every number, z-score and threshold is computed in code (robust median/MAD score, a money floor so tiny moves never trigger), the accounts behind each flagged move are named with only the facts the data shows (a cancellation reason, a plan change, a decline code), and a short chat post is drafted. It never claims a cause the data cannot show, never changes anything in the payments account, and posts nothing until you approve that exact text.

skills.name: Revenue anomaly check
skills.description: Compares a day's new, churned, expansion, contraction and net new MRR and failed payments against a trailing baseline, computed in code from your subscriptions, flags what is unusual, names the accounts behind each move, and drafts a chat post that is sent only after you approve it.
